title: Everyday things
descriptionFa: کارهای هر روز و گاه‌به‌گاه، و پرسیدن درباره‌ی برنامه‌ی روزانه.

words.example: I go to work at eight o'clock.
words.tipFa: بدون the: go to work، نه go to the work.

words.example: Excuse me, I need to go to the bathroom.
When I feel lonely, I phone a friend.
I wash clothes on Saturday mornings.
words.tipFa: do the washing هم همین معنی رو داره.

words.example: Before Nowruz, everyone helps to clean the house.
words.tipFa: خونه‌تکونی قبل از عید: spring cleaning.

words.example: After dinner we often go for a walk in the park.
I write emails to my clients every morning.
I usually get up at seven, but today I got up at nine.
words.tipFa: برای عادت حال، usually، نه used to. used to برای عادت‌های گذشته‌ست.

words.example: How often do you go to the cinema?
words.tipFa: جواب: three times a week, once a month, every day.

words.example: I go to the gym three times a week.
words.tipFa: یک بار: once a week. دو بار: twice a week.
